correctness.rationale: Exact generator calculation yields Lf=Lambda f at zero and interior. Positive finite-time martingale holds by Poisson domination. The tilted gap is M/M/1 with birth beta_theta and death delta; its exponential stationary moment is integrable exactly under B_theta<delta, and exponential Lyapunov control yields expectation convergence. Tilted ergodic speed equals Lambda-prime, giving both local large-deviation bounds. Separate checker passed 1265 exact rational generator identities and 72 independent finite-state matrix-exponential comparisons. The proof, not tests, supplies infinite-time quantifiers.

value.rationale: Natural non-Gaussian rare-event statistics of a stable exclusion cloud are absent from the earlier exact two-particle LLN/variance/CLT. The local tilted equivalence to a free bilateral-Poisson walk has a nontrivial initial-gap amplitude and a closed local speed-deviation rate. It has potential use for atypical transport and initial-condition sensitivity and is not an arbitrary finite numerical slice.
